classification: Explicit canonical event metadata normalization, existing standalone availability and fixed event goals unchanged
source_cause: Advancement-only seasonal_gift and resource_rush have no indexed dedicated rule, but their pre-existing native_options.jem_dedicated_event=true already overrides the computed rule flag in compiler quest.update. Raid and Blood Moon already have dedicated indexed rules. All four goals were therefore already marked dedicated-only before normalization
implementation_choice: Explicit dedicated_event card metadata normalizes classification while preserving existing native_options overrides and indexed rule flags. This is not a fix for a previously false effective availability flag
candidate_generation: Seven chapters,606 mapped cards, three retained optional dedicated goals. Retired Resource Rush remains historical evidence only
